paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Hezekiah in huai azaktak in apuansilhte abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh a, TOUPA' inn ah alutta hi.
heading: Kumpipa'n Isai Ngaihdan Adong / (2 Kum 19.1-7)
english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh’s house.

paite: A-inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Eliakim leh laigelhmi Shebna leh siampute upate sai-ip puan silh in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kiang ah asawl hi.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

paite: Amau akiang ah, Hezekiah in hichi in achi, "Tuni mangbatna leh muhsitna ni ahi; naupangte lah apian hun uh ahita a, amau piangsak ding in hatna lah a-om nawn kei.
english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth.

paite: Rabshakeh apu Assuria kumpipa'n Pathian hing gense ding a asawl thugente, TOUPA na Pathian in abil in aza lai ahi kha ding buchi in athugen, TOUPA na Pathian in abil a azakte ah, ahon sal ding hi; huaiziak in akhosuaksunte a ding in na thumna lan in achi,” achi uhi.
english: It may be Yahweh your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah sikhate Isai kiang ah ahong pai uhi.
english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

paite: Isai in akiang uah, "Na pu kiang uah hichi in na chi ding uh, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Na thuzak, Assuria kumpipa sikhate'n ahon gensiatnate uh, kihta ke'n.
english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘Yahweh says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

paite: Ngai in, asung ah kha banghiam ka omsak ding a, huchi in thuthang aza ding a, amah gam ah akik nawn mai ding; huchi in amah gam ngei ah namsau a puksak in ka omsak ding, achi,' chi in," achi hi.
english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

paite: Huchi in Rabshakeh akik nawn a, Assuria kumpipa in Libnah adouna a kipan apaikheta chih athei khinta hi.
heading: Assuriate'n Vauna Dang Akhak nawn Uh / (2 Kum 19.8-19)
english: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.

paite: Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in Tirhak Ethiopia kumpipa tungthu, "Nang hon sim ding in apawtta," chi in mi gen aza hi. Huchi in huai azaktak in Hezekiah kiang ah palaite asawl a.
english: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

paite: Hichi in Judahte kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah na chi ding uh ahi, “Na muan Pathian in, Jerusalem khua Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in hon khem kei hen.
english: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

paite: Ngai in, Assuria Kumpipate'n gam tengteng hihse vek in atung ua athilhihte uh na bil in na za hi, huchi in nang penpen humbit in na om tuam ding hiam?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?

paite: Namte pathiante'n, Gozan, Haran, Reseph, Eden ta Telassar a omte, ka pipute sukmante, ahumbit ngei ua hia?
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

paite: Hamath kumpipate, Ivvah kumpipate koi a om ahita ua? chi in," achi a.
english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

paite: Hezekiah in palaite khut a kipan in lai amu a, asim a, huchi in TOUPA' inn ah Hezekiah ava lut a, TOUPA ma ah aphahta hi.
english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to Yahweh’s house, and spread it before Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah Hezekiah athum hi.
english: Hezekiah prayed to Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian aw, cherubte tung a tupa, nang, nang kia, leitung luah gam tengteng Pathian na hi; nangma'n leitung leh van na bawl hi.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

paite: TOUPA aw na bildoh inla, ngai dih ve; TOUPA aw na mit hak inla, en dih ve; Pathian hing gense ding a mite sawlpa Sennakerib thu tengteng ngai in.
english: Turn your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.

paite: TOUPA, Assuria kumpipate'n nam tengteng leh agam uh ahihse ngei ua, apathiante uh leng mei ah apai uhi.
english: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,

paite: Huaite zaw Pathian ahi kei him ua, mihing khut a bawl sing leh suang, ahi zaw uh. Huaiziak in ahihmang uhi.
english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, nang, nang kia, TOUPA na hi chih leitung luah gam tengteng in atheihna ding un amah a kipan in hon humbit in," chi in.
english: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahweh, even you only.”

paite: Huai lai in Amoz tapa Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah mi asawl a, hichi in achi, "TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib siatna ding nangawn a ka kiang a na thum ziak in,
heading: Kumpipa Kiang A Isai Thugen / (2 Kum 19.20-37)
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

paite: hiai atungtang thu TOUPA'N agen ahi, 'Nungak siangthou, Zion tanu in ahon musit a, hon nuihsan hi; Jerusalem tanu in alu hon sinkhum hi.
english: this is the word which Yahweh has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

paite: Kua ahi mai a na minsiatsak a na gensiat? Kua tung ah ahia na aw na puamsak a, na mit na sansak? Israelte Mi Siangthou tung ah ahi kei maw.
english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Na sikhate zang in TOUPA min na sesak a, ka kangtalai tampi toh tang sang sanna, Lebanon gam kil ah ka hong tungtouta hi; asidar sing sangtakte leh ameilah sing hoihte ka phuk ding; amun sangpen, alei hoihna gammang ah ka lut ding.
english: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.

paite: Tuileh ka let a, tui ka dawn zel a, ka khepek nuai in Aigupta lui tengteng ka kangsak vek ding, " na chi hi.
english: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”

paite: Ke'n nidanglai a pan in huai ka hih ahi a, tuma lam a kipan a ka suktuah ahi chih na za kei a hia? Khua kulh neite inn chimkhawm bang lel a hihsepa na hihtheihna ding in tu in ka tungsak hi.
english: “‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities, turning them into ruinous heaps.

paite: Huaiziak in asung a omte ahat lo kei ua, alau ua, azahlak uhi; loubuk loupa bang lel leh loupa hing bang lel, intung loupa hing bang lel, intung loupa bang leh lou buh hoih mah bang lel ahi uhi.
english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like a field before its crop has grown.

paite: "Ke'n bel na tut, na pawt, na lut leh ka tung a na hehdan ka thei hi.
english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

paite: Ka tung a na heh ziak leh na uangpau ka bil a ahong luttouh tak ziak in ka nakbulh nang nak ah ka bulh ding a, ka sikkaihna leng na muk ah ka bulh ding, na hong paina lampi mah ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding, chih," chi in.
english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.

paite: "Huan hiai pen nang a ding a chiamtehna ding ahi ding; tukum in buhsang na sen ding ua; kum nawn in leng huai buhsang mah na sen ding uh; akum thumna ah buh tuh unla, at unla, grephuante bawl unla, agah ne un.
english: “‘This shall be the sign to you: You will eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from it; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

paite: "Huan Judah inkuanpihte lak a akhosuaksunte bel asuklam a zungkai a, atoulam a gah in a-om nawn ding.
english: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

paite: Akhosuaksunte Jerusalem a kipan in apawt ding ua, dam lai dingte Zion tang a kipan in apawt ding uh; sepaihte' TOUPA phatuamngaihna in huaite ahih ding hi.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.’

paite: "Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria kumpipa tungtang thu ah hichi in achi: Amah hiai khopi ahong tung kei ding a, hiai lai ah athal leng akap sam kei ding a, lum toh akiang ah leng ahong pai sam kei ding, asimna ding in lah leikulh abawl sam kei ding.
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

paite: Ahong paina lampi ah huai mah ah akik nawn ding ziak in, hiai khopi ah ahong tung kei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: He will return the way that he came, and he won’t come to this city,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Kei ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi ka humbit ding hi,” chỉ in achi a.
english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA angel ava pawt a, Assuriate giahmun ah mi nuaikhat singgiat-le-sangnga asisak a; huan, zingkhang a mi athoh uleh, ngai in, misi luang ngen ana hi uhi.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib apawt a, apaikik a, Nineveh ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, apathian Nisrok inn a pathian abiak lai in atapa Adrammelek leh Sarezerte'n namsau in asatlum ua; huchi in ataimang ua, Ararat gam ah alut uhi. Huchi in atapa Esarhaddon in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
